title: Mechanical Services (PBS)
activity: LTHW/CHW pipework, ductwork and plant – install, test, insulation
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Installed to the PBS construction drawing, coordinated, access to valves kept?
Brackets within the typical centres (steel 25–32 mm ≤2.4–2.7 m), pipework plumb and level, expansion loops/bellows fitted?

guide.title: Pipe support centres – typical max
guide.note: Typical industry values – the manufacturer's / PBS drawing figure governs. Anything sagging fails regardless.
guide.src: BS EN 806 / BS 8000-15 typical tables; CLM tested details (400 mm)

questions.q: Open ends capped, drain cocks and air vents fitted at low/high points?
Fire sleeves/collars fitted at fire walls and floors?
Ask the fitter: What pressure was it tested to and when? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Pipework pressure tested (at least working pressure) before insulation?
Ductwork leakage tested to DW/143 where scheduled?
Insulation and trace heating inspected before cladding; valves operable when lagged?
Services labelled, flow direction shown, plant accessible for maintenance?

notOk.t: Drop rod clips out of alignment
Supports missing either side of fire-stopped penetrations
